activity_summary: You took broth and the soft side of the loaf, and you did not call the jaw healed. Alse brushed Saturday's mud off the hem. You said you are not in the Shrew, and that the afternoon's writing is a kitchen with an empty margin. You promised to bring no Christmas sum home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the jaw tender, declined the afternoon play, and refused a sum in advance.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept him to broth and to the threepence, and told him not to bring a figure home.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the loaf, brushed the hem, and left the cat in the chair.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Broth, and the hem

entities.name: the Shrew
entities.context: Mentioned in Broth, and the hem

facets.activity: Ate broth and said the afternoon writing was a kitchen

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Today I will not pretend it is healed.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: The hem has Saturday's mud on it still.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have no sum to bring you.
